review.summary: Candidate head 8200ed3b closes both P4 hardening notes from the prior final review at 1d98ee0d. The residual dead ternary at src/desktop-read-model.mjs:510 is replaced with `authority_open: false` plus a one-line comment that artifact-supplied projection authority is observed only (line 511); the HERMES_REPO_ROOT env override is now gated through a new apps/desktop/src/main/repo-root.mjs::resolveHermesRepoRoot helper that resolves the env value through realpathSync, requires the candidate root to expose package.json with name `hermes-project-ops-harness`, a sibling src/desktop-read-model.mjs, and apps/desktop/package.json, and otherwise falls back to the default APP_DIR/../.. root. Both the desktop main process (apps/desktop/src/main/main.mjs:12-16) and the smoke capture runner (apps/desktop/scripts/capture-render.mjs:14-18) consume the same resolver. A dedicated test in apps/desktop/test/repo-root.test.mjs covers (a) the checked-out Hermes root being accepted, (b) an arbitrary empty tmpdir env being ignored and falling back to the default root, and (c) the unset env case. The HERMES_REPO_ROOT override is also documented in docs/hermes-desktop-local-launch-runbook-2026-06-14.md (Repository Root Override section) with both the gating rules and an `unset HERMES_REPO_ROOT` recommendation before release/package rehearsal. All six original findings from the initial Claude review remain remediated at this head: redaction of 'desktop write authority enabled' (apps/desktop/src/main/read-model.mjs:320), realpath-based repo-root containment for the source preview (read-model.mjs:60-66), CSP style-src 'self' only (apps/desktop/src/main/security-policy.mjs:30), hardcoded false tag_pushed/github_release_published in buildReleaseProjection (src/desktop-read-model.mjs:447-450), source_id lookup for factory_gate_opening and factory_stage_6_7 (src/desktop-read-model.mjs:466-471), and Unknown-argument-throwing CLI parsers in all three desktop scripts (src/desktop-read-model.mjs:795-813, src/desktop-authority-boundary.mjs:405-423, src/desktop-packaging-manifest.mjs:356-375). A grep for the pattern `=== true ? false : false` across the repo returns no matches, confirming no residual dead ternary remains. The 2026-06-15 release decision packet, production launch checklist, claude review packet, and release-note/tag draft each frame production PASS, enterprise PASS, enterprise trust claim, GitHub independent approval, protected closeout, deployment authorization, tag creation, tag push, GitHub Release publication, desktop write authority, runtime execution, connector write, secret read, raw source exposure, and auto-update/package publication as not granted, not pursued, missing, draft only, or intentionally blocked; no production/enterprise/closeout overclaim observed. One non-blocking P3 documentation drift remains: the 2026-06-15 release decision packet, production launch checklist, and release-note/tag draft were authored in commit ade7c40c against prior head 1d98ee0d and still cite that commit as the candidate, while the actual candidate head 8200ed3b adds the two P4 closures on top; the docs should be refreshed to cite 8200ed3b before any owner RC re-freeze decision so the approved evidence baseline matches the head that contains the P4 hardening. No P0/P1/P2 regression introduced. This review is read-only and does not authorize production PASS, enterprise PASS, protected closeout, deployment, GitHub independent approval, tag creation, tag push, GitHub Release publication, or desktop write authority.

residual_risks: The 2026-06-15 release decision packet, production launch checklist, and release-note/tag draft cite prior head 1d98ee0d as the candidate; the actual candidate head 8200ed3b is the one that includes the P4 hardening. Authority flags in those docs remain forced closed, but the candidate-pointer drift should be reconciled before any owner RC re-freeze so the approved baseline matches the head under review.

apps/desktop/src/main/repo-root.mjs gating accepts any directory whose package.json declares name 'hermes-project-ops-harness' and that exposes src/desktop-read-model.mjs and apps/desktop/package.json. In a single-owner local context this is sufficient; in a future shared/CI environment a hostile fork with the same package name and shape would still satisfy the gate, so the resolver should not be treated as a defense against an adversarial filesystem.

Symlink containment for source previews depends on realpath at preview time. A TOCTOU race where the symlink target is swapped between realpath() and readFile() exists in principle; not practically exploitable in single-owner local mode but worth noting if the desktop is ever co-tenanted.

Smoke-test forbidden-copy guard depends on redactPreviewText (apps/desktop/src/main/read-model.mjs:309-321) staying in sync with FORBIDDEN_DESKTOP_TRUST_COPY (apps/desktop/src/shared/shell-state.mjs:40-50). Both lists currently agree, but they are still maintained independently; consolidating into a single shared source would prevent future drift.

Packaging manifest validation (src/desktop-packaging-manifest.mjs) relies on substring scans for electron-updater/autoUpdater references; a renamed updater dependency or obfuscated reference could pass undetected. Boundary is appropriate for the named risk surface but is not a general-purpose updater detector.

Local validation evidence supplied in the review prompt (`git diff --check` pass, `npm audit --prefix apps/desktop` 0 vulnerabilities, `npm run test:desktop` 19/0, `node --test test/desktop-read-model.test.mjs` 7/0, `npm run desktop:local-preflight` pass, `npm run validate:core` pass, `npm run release:candidate -- --check` pass, `npm run release:freeze -- --check` pass, `npm run platform:release-readiness-control-plane -- --check` pass deployment-allowed false, `npm run platform:release-bundle-provenance -- --check` pass, `npm run platform:launch-non-human-readiness -- --check` pass authority flags closed) was not re-executed by this read-only review and should be re-verified before any owner RC re-freeze decision. The umbrella `npm run platform:release-check -- --check` was reported as interrupted in the prompt and is not treated as passing.
